Container.Name: FastDAV
Container.Overview: FastDAV - a fast, lightweight, fully compliant WebDAV server (RFC 4918 class 1 + 2, RFC 4331 quotas) with per-device app passwords. Works with Windows Explorer, macOS Finder, Linux, iOS/Android file managers, rclone, Joplin, Obsidian, Zotero, KeePass and more. Manage users and app passwords at http://[IP]:[PORT]/.fastdav/

Config.Name: WebDAV Port
Config.Description: HTTP(S) port for WebDAV and the account page.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Folder shared over WebDAV. Users' home folders are relative to this.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Admin password (min 8 chars). Re-applied on every start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id files are written as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id files are written as (100 = users).

Config.Name: URL prefix
Config.Description: Serve under a sub-path, e.g. /dav (for reverse proxies).

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Use X-Forwarded-For for client IPs (enable only behind a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Max login failures
Config.Description: Failed logins per IP in 5 min before a 15 min block. 0 disables.

Config.Name: CORS origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated origins allowed for browser-based WebDAV clients, or *.

Config.Name: TLS certificate
Config.Description: Path inside the container to a PEM certificate (e.g. /config/cert.pem) to serve HTTPS directly.

Config.Name: TLS key
Config.Description: Path to the matching PEM private key.
